meta.title: Log in
meta.description: Log in to the BlueGenji Esport member area with your Google account or a Discord code.

page.title: Log in
page.codeSeparator: OR A CODE BY DIRECT MESSAGE
page.handleHelp: The bot has to share a server with you to message you privately, whether you enter your tag or your ID: the ID only saves the bot from looking up your tag. Not on one of its servers yet? <join>Join us</join> — or just use the Discord button above, which works without a shared server.
page.codeSent: Code sent by Discord DM (expires at {time}).
page.tagNotice: Logging in with this code saves this tag without certifying it: it stays hidden from everyone, admins included. If you certify it later in “My profile”, {audience}
page.pseudoHelp: Only used when your account is created: if you already have one, it keeps its username.

oauth.discordNote: Saves your Discord username without certifying it: it stays hidden from everyone, admins included. If you certify it later with one click in “My profile”, {audience}
oauth.tagAudience: admins can see it at any time, referees while you are registered for a tournament that is not finished (from the moment registration opens), and the players and caster of your match for the duration of the match, once it is launched; other players only if you make it visible in your privacy settings. Never anyone else.

notice.IOS_INSTALLED_APP: You are using the site from its home screen icon: iOS often blocks logging in with Google, Discord or Blizzard there. If it fails, open the site in Safari, or use the Discord code by direct message below.
notice.IN_APP_BROWSER: You are browsing inside an app's built-in browser, which often blocks logging in with Google, Discord or Blizzard. If it fails, open the site in your usual browser, or use the Discord code by direct message below.

advice.IOS_INSTALLED_APP: From the home screen icon, iOS isolates the login: open the site in Safari to log in, or use the Discord code by direct message.
advice.IN_APP_BROWSER: This app's built-in browser blocks the login: open the site in your usual browser (Safari, Chrome, Firefox…), or use the Discord code by direct message.

errors.BOT_INTERNAL_UNREACHABLE: Discord login unavailable (the bot cannot be reached). You can use Google instead.
errors.BOT_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT: The bot could not find your tag in time. If you are on the BlueGenji server, use your Discord ID instead; otherwise, use the Discord button.
errors.BOT_INTERNAL_UNAUTHORIZED: Discord login unavailable (invalid internal token). You can use Google instead.
errors.DISCORD_DM_FAILED: Could not send you the code by direct message: the bot has to share a server with you, and your DMs must be open there. Join the BlueGenji server, or use the Discord button.
errors.DISCORD_USER_NOT_FOUND: Tag not found: the bot has to share a server with you. Join the BlueGenji server, or use the Discord button.
errors.FAILED_TO_SEND_CODE: The code could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
errors.INVALID_DISCORD_HANDLE: Enter your Discord tag or your ID.
errors.CODE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED: Invalid or expired code. Ask for a new one.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODE_REQUESTS: Too many codes requested for this Discord account. Wait about fifteen minutes, or log in with Google.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODE_REQUESTS_TODAY: Too many codes requested for this Discord account today. Log in with the Discord button or Google, or try again tomorrow.
errors.INVALID_CHALLENGE: Code request not found. Ask for a new code.
errors.CROSS_SITE_REQUEST: Request refused. Reload the login page, then try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: Request refused. Reload the login page, then try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait about fifteen minutes, or log in with Google.
errors.DISCORD_AUTH_FAILED: Discord login failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.TERMS_REQUIRED: To create your account, accept the terms of use. Reload the page to see them.

oauthErrors.not_configured: {provider} login unavailable: configuration missing. Try another way to log in.
oauthErrors.unavailable: {provider} login temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
oauthErrors.params: {provider} login interrupted. Start the login again from this page.
oauthErrors.state: Login session expired or invalid. Start the login again.
oauthErrors.oauth: {provider} login failed. Try again in a moment.
oauthErrors.session: You need to be logged in to link an app. Log in, then try again.
oauthErrors.terms: To create your account, accept the terms of use, then start the login again.

suspension.title: Account suspended
suspension.spanUntil: This account is suspended until {end} (decision {reference}): you cannot log in while the suspension lasts.
suspension.spanIndefinite: This account is suspended indefinitely (decision {reference}): you cannot log in while the suspension lasts.
suspension.groundText: Terms of use (in French), <terms>“{clause}”</terms>. Decision made by a member of the moderation team, with no automated processing.
suspension.appealText: Use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Autre” (Other — no login needed), quoting decision {reference} and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision. You can then take the decision to the competent court.
suspension.loginUntil: This account is suspended until {end}. The reason was sent to you by Discord direct message if your account is linked to Discord. To appeal: use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Autre” (Other — no login needed), quoting the decision you received and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision — then, if needed, the competent court.
suspension.loginIndefinite: This account is suspended indefinitely. The reason was sent to you by Discord direct message if your account is linked to Discord. To appeal: use “Report a problem” at the bottom of any page of the site, category “Autre” (Other — no login needed), quoting the decision you received and leaving a way to reply to you: the association will review its decision — then, if needed, the competent court.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.intro: To run your account, BlueGenji processes only the data strictly needed for the service you ask for:
consent.pseudonyms: Only pseudonyms (site, Discord and game usernames) and an avatar — no real name, phone number or address: an account created through Google now gets a neutral username, never your name, and a photo copied from Google or Discord stays hidden until you choose to show it. The ID of the provider you log in with (Google, Discord or Blizzard) is also kept for authentication.
consent.gameNames: Your Overwatch and Marvel Rivals usernames are only used so other players can add you in game, never to compile statistics.
consent.noResale: No resale of data, no advertising trackers, no targeted ads.
consent.discordTag: Logging in with Discord saves your Discord username without certifying it: nobody sees it until you certify it yourself in your profile.
consent.export: You can export or delete your data from your profile at any time.
consent.policy: Full details in our <policy>privacy policy (in French)</policy>. If you go back, no account is created; only the site's audience measurement may have counted your visit.
consent.terms: I have read and accept the terms of use (<terms>read the terms, in French</terms>), and I declare that I am at least {age} years old.
